title: Basic Beginners FreeCAD v1.0 : Introduction to Course
summary: The introduction to MangoJelly's beginner course for FreeCAD 1.0. The course teaches solid modeling with the Part Design, Sketcher and Part workbenches.
why: HN users recommend MangoJelly's thorough tutorials as the best way to learn FreeCAD properly, since trial and error doesn't work.

quote.text: MangoJelly has done an amazing job in churning out high quality tutorials for FreeCAD
